signals.visits: non-updating-player visits, primary seed, final checkpoint
signals.movement: L1(avg strategy at earlier=10k vs final) primary seed; NaN if absent earlier
signals.seed_disagreement: mean pairwise L1 across seeds 0-2 at final; NaN if <2 seeds have key
signals.collision: strength-ladder range among >=5 corpus members / 7; NaN otherwise

decision_rule: any reject reason -> REJECT; else any low reason -> LOW; else ACCEPT; visits<=0 or missing -> REJECT UNSEEN_STATE; NaN sd AND NaN mv adds NO_STABILITY_DATA (low)

reasons.HIGH_COLLISION_DISPERSION: the abstract key merges strategically different hands
reasons.CONFIG_MISMATCH: strategy trained under a different solver config
reasons.UNSEEN_STATE: information set never visited in training
reasons.OUTSIDE_ABSTRACTION: spot cannot be mapped into the abstract game
reasons.KNOWN_PATHOLOGICAL_BUCKET: key flagged by the strategy audit
reasons.NO_STABILITY_DATA: no checkpoint / seed stability data for this key
reasons.OFF_TREE_TRANSLATION: observed bet sizes were translated onto the abstract tree
reasons.ILLEGAL_SIZE_MASS: a large share of the solver's mass was on sizes below the NLHE minimum and was removed
reasons.STREET_ABSTRACTION_ERROR: flop / turn keys of this abstraction measurably merge strategically different hands (exact subgame study)

calibration_source: results/validation/solver_gate_calibration.json (3 exact games x 3k/30k, movement horizon 3k->30k; production movement horizon 10k->final)
